title: T > 1 means at most 2 calls in the first minute
caption: The 3rd call comes after time 1 exactly when the count N of calls in the first minute is 0, 1 or 2, where N ~ Poisson(2): P(T > 1) = e⁻²(1 + 2 + 2) = 0.6767.
alt: Bar chart of the Poisson distribution with mean 2; the bars at 0, 1 and 2 are shaded, total 0.6767.
description: In one minute the number of calls is Poisson with mean 2.
T > 1 minute means fewer than 3 calls have arrived.
The three shaded bars add to 5e⁻² = 0.6767.
